subject.title: refactor(mobile): consolidate native gateway and voice lifecycles

question: After the branch is refreshed onto current main and the remaining Android and iOS checks pass, should the mobile owner approve this availability-sensitive lifecycle consolidation for landing?
rationale: The patch is protected by the `maintainer` label and changes concurrent native lifecycle behavior across Android and iOS; automated review cannot safely replace the final owner judgment.

options.title: Refresh and approve
options.body: Rebase onto current main, verify the remaining platform checks on the mergeable head, then approve if the owner agrees the consolidated helpers preserve existing lifecycle semantics.

options.title: Request a narrower split
options.body: Ask for the independent Vitest inventory and Swift test-stability fixes to be separated if maintaining a platform-only lifecycle refactor would make ownership review clearer.

recommendation.title: Refresh and approve
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, verify the remaining platform checks on the mergeable head, then approve if the owner agrees the consolidated helpers preserve existing lifecycle semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: A named current-main mobile owner could not be established from the available read-only evidence without guessing.
